title: MULTINOMIAL owns a private Lanczos lgamma and has no numeric evidence at all
status_plain: MULTINOMIAL does not route through any shared gamma path. It carries its OWN Lanczos log-gamma: a g of 7.0 and a nine-coefficient table declared in multinomial.rs at lines 41-50, together with two publication ULP clamps (a 3-ULP clamp for the two-positive case and a 4-ULP radius for the multi-positive case). That places it on the same substrate class as the GAMMA and COMBIN wall - the family of surfaces whose residual is an internal extended-precision lgamma/exp composition. It appears in no discrepancy catalogue row, in no Excel-math-deviation entry and in no numeric sweep, so it has ZERO numeric evidence against Excel. Everything MULTINOMIAL is credited with comes from one group total on the structural axis: it is a named member of the 46-of-47 array-lift resweep, where it contributed the aggregate-to-a-scalar case MULTINOMIAL({2;3}) -> 10. The ULP clamps are themselves a disclosure: a kernel that clamps its own publication to within 3 or 4 ULP is not asserting bit agreement with anything.
